## Pull requests

- Branch from `__DEFAULT_BRANCH__` (default: `main`) and target pull requests at it.
- Keep changes focused and describe their impact.
- Update documentation when behavior or setup changes.
- Run the scaffold check (`node scripts/check-scaffold.mjs`) and the project's own validation before requesting review.
- Do not include secrets, credentials, or private user data.
- Preserve the repository's license and any third-party notices.
